caption.text:
@joshjanssenn hikes for views like these 🏞️⁣
⁣
The filmmaker has always been drawn to exploring somewhere unfamiliar, especially spots very few have seen in person.⁣
⁣
“I want people to discover these places through my videos and feel inspired to experience that kind of beauty for themselves.”⁣
⁣
Video by @joshjanssenn

@joshjanssenn hikes for views like these 🏞️  

 The filmmaker has always been drawn to exploring somewhere unfamiliar, especially spots very few have seen in person.  

 “I want people to discover these places through my videos and feel inspired to experience that kind of beauty for themselves.”  

 Video by @joshjanssenn
